_handoff.scopeNote: Official-source pass for transferring a domestic LPG connection after a Bengaluru move or family/name change. Public material only; no login, OTP, identity entry, upload, payment, distributor request, or submission was attempted.

documentationShelf.title: Bharatgas Unified Transfer/Regularization Form
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Official common OMC transfer form: SV/consumer details, transferor/transferee, five transfer/regularization types, declarations and distributor verification.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: Form is not a case decision, Bengaluru distributor assignment, fee quote, or proof that every OMC uses the same front-end.

documentationShelf.title: Bharatgas LPG Gas Manual (transfer FAQ)

documentationShelf.whereItStops: PDF is dated 2021 and does not establish current Bengaluru distributor capacity, fee, service clock, or inter-town handling.

documentationShelf.title: Bharatgas LPG Services
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Public service index lists distributor search, KYC need, contact updates, online new connection and downloads.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: No account or connection lookup was used; the index does not expose a case-specific transfer decision.

claims.text: The official Bharatgas transfer form provides Type A transfer by subscriber to family member, Type B outside-family transfer, Type C transfer without transferor consent, Type D next-of-kin transfer after death, and Type E regularization where equipment is held without the subscription voucher.
claims.notes: A form option is not an approval or an indication that a particular case qualifies.

claims.text: Bharatgas's public manual says that when a customer shifts within the operating area of the same distributor, the customer should advise the distributor of the new address with supporting residence proof so the distributor changes its records and future supplies go to the new address.
claims.notes: Manual is dated April 2021; current distributor practice and accepted proof list are unknown.

claims.text: For a move within the same town where the present distributor does not service the new address, the manual says to approach the old distributor with the original Subscription Voucher for a Transfer Termination Voucher/City Transfer Advise Out, then approach the new distributor with residence proof, TTV/CTA Out and DGCC booklet; the new distributor prepares TSV/CTA In and provides a new consumer number.
claims.notes: This is a published OMC workflow, not an observed Bengaluru transaction.

claims.text: The official transfer form requires the transferee to be an Indian citizen above 18, submit documents required by the distributor and deposit equipment security under the distributor's terms; it also declares no existing PSU OMC domestic LPG connection in the same household and an independent household/kitchen.
claims.notes: The form does not provide a universal current document checklist or case-specific fee.

claims.text: Bharatgas's customer declaration says that whenever a customer changes residence, the LPG distributor is to be informed in writing in advance so the address can be updated in records.
claims.notes: Declaration is a standard customer undertaking, not evidence that an online transfer route is available.

claims.text: No reviewed official public source establishes the current Bengaluru OMC/distributor for a supplied address, current transfer fee/security amount, accepted proof variants, inter-town route, processing status, or whether a particular transfer will be approved.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, connection number, distributor lookup, upload, payment, or submission was performed.

edges.label: Route selection determines the relevant address and identity evidence.
Transfer relationship/event determines the form type and declarations.
Same-town route uses the old distributor's TTV/CTA Out before the receiving distributor's TSV/CTA In.
Distributor processing would update records and future supply; no outcome was observed.

roadblocks.title: OMC/distributor service-area boundary
roadblocks.symptom: A move may be within the old distributor's area, within the same town but another distributor, or outside the town.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Current distributor assignment and area coverage are case-specific.
roadblocks.recovery: Confirm OMC, old distributor, new address and receiving distributor before selecting same-area versus voucher transfer.

roadblocks.title: Case-specific proof and physical verification
roadblocks.symptom: The sources name proof classes and a verification block but do not provide a current universal Bengaluru checklist.
roadblocks.likelyCause: OMC, transfer type, household/de-duplication and distributor practice affect requirements.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the selected OMC's current form and distributor instructions; do not upload or submit in research mode.
